errors.text: The hypothesis places the decisive ordering inside the B2 phase, whereas the target mechanism is enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains approaching Ni3Al stoichiometry.
It does not make jagged B2/FCC phase-boundary tips and their stress concentrations a necessary part of embrittlement.
The proposed stress-induced martensitic transformation recovery mechanism is imported from a different alloy and fatigue context and is not supported for the target AlCoCrFeNi2.1 aging transition.
It fails to specify the experimentally relevant boundary of less than 550°C, 550–750°C, and greater than 750°C, including the 600°C ductility minimum and 750°C recovery.
